comment: Dispatch surface of the specialized SM90 CuTe-DSL per-token-group fp8 quantizer, behind per_token_group_quant_8bit's 'specialized' backend. 'backends' lists the backend strings; the op entry carries the auto-routing keys (the compiled-in guards in flashinfer/quantization/fp8_quantization.py stay authoritative). backend='auto' routes to the specialized kernel only when this file is present and well-formed; FLASHINFER_SPECIALIZED_KERNEL_DISABLE=1 forces the stock routes regardless of this file.

per_token_group_quant_8bit.input: 2D contiguous bfloat16 CUDA tensor, last dim a multiple of 128, nonzero numel
per_token_group_quant_8bit.scales: row-major float32 (column_major_scales / scale_tma_aligned / scale_ue8m0 all false)
